info.name: Notification Service - Delete Endpoints
info.description: Delete endpoints for Notification Service - Firebase Cloud Messaging

header.description: Required: JWT token for authenticated requests. userId and tenantId are extracted from the token.

variable.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the notification to delete

request.description: Delete a single notification (soft delete). Users can only delete their own notifications. userId and tenantId are extracted from the JWT token. Returns 404 if notification not found or already deleted.

header.description: Required: JWT token for authenticated requests. userId and tenantId are extracted from the token.

request.description: Delete all notifications for the authenticated user (soft delete). userId and tenantId are extracted from the JWT token. Returns the count of deleted notifications.

variable.description: JWT access token for authenticated requests
